d: Enjoy this beautiful song Solah Baras Ki Baali Umar sung by Lata Mangeshkar and Anup Jalota from the blockbuster romantic movie of 1981 Ek Duuje Ke Liye starring Kamal Hassan & Rati Agnihotri in the lead. The music is composed by veteran music composers Laxmikant Pyarelal and the lyrics are penned by Anand Bakshi. The movie is Directed by K. Balachander.
